from datetime import datetime, timedelta

start_date_str = "2025-08-08"
business_days_needed = 27
holidays = {"2025-08-20", "2025-08-25", "2025-09-19", "2025-10-30"}

start_date = datetime.strptime(start_date_str, "%Y-%m-%d")

# Method 2: Generate all candidate dates, filter to business days, then index
candidate_dates = [
    start_date + timedelta(days=i)
    for i in range(70)
]

# Filter to business days only (weekday < 5 means Mon-Fri, exclude holidays)
business_days = [
    d for d in candidate_dates
    if d.weekday() < 5 and d.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") not in holidays
]

# Get the 27th business day (index 26, since list is 0-indexed)
result = business_days[business_days_needed - 1]

print(f"ANSWER: {result.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
